title: BLOG: The human-in-the-loop paradox: who will validate the AI in Future?
description: 1. The human-in-the-loop paradox: who will validate the AI in Future? What's missing: The market talks about AI preserving the knowledge of retiring experts. Almost nobody talks about the reverse: AI is taking over the junior analysis work that turns people into experts in the first place. The argument: Human-in-the-loop only works if the human knows more than the AI. If AI does all the entry-level analysis, you stop producing the experts you'll need to check it. Call it competence debt: it builds up silently and comes due when a model fails. The PoV would propose about how to overcome this.
